acceptance.failure: LS-04 (S1, LN-27): the unit's O-only pass waits, and the item takes its fallback
acceptance.rule: a regenerated unit is accepted only if its e1 adapter fingerprint, its training identity, its prepared manifest and its data config equal the source unit's; the code and recipe hashes are reported (addendum section 11 point 2; REV3 section 1.5)

cap.branch_128: W1-18's truncation check passed over every unit (ADD section 9; REV3 section 6.3)
cap.branch_full: W1-18's truncation check failed (ADD section 9; REV3 section 6.3)
cap.no_record: no W1-18 record at the W1 commit, or no LN-13 record in FOCUS of how the judge weights reached the Mac: Branch full (LN-13)

cost: about $0.14 per regeneration and about $0.7 per unit for 400 PHTest answers at the full cap (E, UNVERIFIED answer lengths; REV3 section 6.3); block A
data_root: tmp/ (the main checkout's git-ignored folder; every unit path below starts there)

engine.rule: every regeneration runs on engine X with recipe S (REC's training identity); Gate A's a0 units ran on engine 55253874 with REC, so their code and recipe hashes are reported, not required

fallback: LN-12's fallback (review-statistics ST-13): P1-P3's O comparator part uses one seed set for all 500 prompts, the R seeds among 1104-1107 with 500-bank answers; the record prints J; with fewer than 3 such seeds the O comparator part of P1-P3 is not tested and O_k's IUT cannot reject
name: build_reuse_spec
never: no state is pulled from a stopped Gate B kit pod (PREREG revision 5 section 9: a stopped kit pod is never restarted; REV3 section 1.5); a needed adapter is regenerated by the fingerprint rule, or the item takes its fallback

o_bank.weights: equal weight per prompt; O = the refusal share over the whole bank, denominator = the bank size; an invalid answer counts as not refused (LN-24; Gate B's Ref definition)

o_pass.fallback: addendum section 11 point 1 (c): if the function is not verified before the S1 freeze, overrefusal_bank.status = dev100_recipe_cap and the pre-registration states that limit
o_pass.rule: the one shared pinned O-ext function (addendum section 11 point 1): it writes new files beside the engine's 8 evaluation files; theta0, a0, R, every arm and B10's references call it

prints: the cap branch and its source
the flag-change share per source (full against cut, where both exist)
O over the bank (equal prompt weights), the per-source O, the invalid count
the dev-100 O under the bank's cap and at the Gate A cap (Gate B's Ref reading)
J: the R seeds with 500-bank answers
each regeneration's fingerprints and identities beside the source's
requirement: LN-12 (addendum section 10; REV3 sections 6.3 and 1.5; REC (d) rule 5): the reused units' fingerprint-checked regeneration and their O-only passes on the 500-prompt bank; addendum section 11 point 1 (the O-only pass is the shared function scripts/stage1_s1/oext_eval.py)

128.dev_100: the engine's dev-100 answers made at the Gate A cap, cut to their first 128 new tokens and judged again, one device per contrast (LN-19)
128.phtest: the O-ext prompts generated with a 128-new-token cap (LN-19)

full.dev_100: generated at the full generation cap
full.phtest: generated at the full generation cap

seal: every output of these jobs falls under block A's seal (LW-35)

sealed_manifest.use: an R unit's arm must be the sealed R_d file's arm, edit-<its SHA-256>, d = seed - 1100

theta0_transfer: LN-14 (Branch 128 only): theta0's PHTest answers made once at the full cap and judged both full and cut by W1-18's bar, a pre-set report; if theta0 fails the bar, the paper states the cut as a limit for PHTest; the cap rule does not switch

units.conditional: only if Gate B's extension ran R_4 (LW-32): its unit is then given with --extension R_1104=…; else R_1104 is a new block-A run, not a reused unit
units.name: R_1104

units.conditional: only if Gate B's extension ran R_5: as R_1104
units.name: R_1105
